messages:
Tara Liu: Flagging OnboardX onboarding — ingestion for their document set is failing validation 422 during our post-ingest check. They're mid-pilot and AM says renewal conversation in ~30 days. Pls prioritize.
Ben Park: Can you paste the error? Is this importer or schema validation?
Tara Liu: Error from processor: `422 invalid_document: missing_required_field 'customer_id'` — they claim they populated all fields. Link to ticket: https://support.redwood/cases/ONB-3321
SupportBot: Case ONB-3321 created and auto-tagged: priority=high; SLA: 6h.
Erin Walsh: I can take a look at the ingestion logs. Aaron — can you reach out to OnboardX engineer to confirm payload sample?
Aaron Cole: Reached out via email, waiting on sample. In the meantime can we provide a temporary mapping so they can continue testing?
Ben Park: Short-term workaround: enable permissive schema flag for their tenant so we skip strict required-field enforcement. We need infra signoff but can toggle for a few hours.
Tara Liu: Do that. Also need a comms plan for the AM to reassure OnboardX — theyve already flagged risk to procurement.
Erin Walsh: Investigating logs now. I see that their ingestion pipeline sometimes nests fields differently (`metadata.customer.id` vs `customer_id`). Our validator doesn't handle nested aliasing.
Aaron Cole: Customer engineer sent sample (attached in ticket). It's nested. They were using an old transform. We can give them a mapping snippet and temporarily enable permissive mode.
Ben Park: I'll request the tenant toggle from infra. ETA 25m.
Tara Liu: For comms: short apology, explanation (schema mismatch due to nested fields), immediate corrective action (permissive toggle + mapping snippet), and remediation plan (update onboarding docs + automated mapping rule). Draft it and tag AM.
Aaron Cole: Drafting mapping snippet to paste to them:
```
# mapping example
if 'metadata' in payload and 'customer' in payload['metadata']:
  customer_id = payload['metadata']['customer'].get('id')
```
Ben Park: Infra responded — permissive flag enabled for OnboardX tenant. I marked it in the ticket. Please confirm ingestion now.
Tara Liu: Asking customer to re-run ingest now.
SupportBot: ONB-3321 status: workaround applied.
Aaron Cole: OnboardX confirms ingest passed validation after toggle; 48 docs processed. They pushed a rollback to old transform to avoid future breaks.
Erin Walsh: Created follow-up task: add aliasing support to validator and a preflight check in onboarding wizard. Estimated dev time: 2 sprints.
Tara Liu: Great. Next items: 1) Send comms to OnboardX (cc AM: Priya Shah) 2) Mark renewal risk = guarded 3) Schedule 1:1 if they want technical handoff
Ben Park: Draft comms uploaded to #customer-success-drafts: "Thanks for the patience. Root cause: mismatch between your transform and our validator. We applied a temporary permissive setting to unblock you and provided a mapping snippet. We're shipping an update to onboarding validation to avoid repeats. Will follow up with a postmortem and optional handoff call. —Ben, CS"
Tara Liu: Sending now and setting renewal flag in the tracker to 'guarded' with note: ingest-failure-blocked-pilot. Priya (AM) will own the renewal check-in.
Aaron Cole: I'll follow up with customer engineering tomorrow morning to make sure mapping is in place.
Erin Walsh: I'll open an engineering ticket and include sample payloads from ONB-3321. Tagging platform team for prioritization.
SupportBot: ONB-3321 status: resolved (workaround applied). Reminder: check for regressions for 72h.
Tara Liu: Thanks team. Great quick move. :white_check_mark:
Ben Park: Thanks all.
Tara Liu: /remind @Priya Shah 48h "Renewal check-in w/ OnboardX after postmortem""
